decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The roof area of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwellin<span style="font-size: 14px;">g at&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">45 Dudley Avenue, Kenton, Harrow, HA3 8ST&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">and shall not at any time be used for commercial purposes or as primary residential accommodation.&nbsp;</span>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">RPA/45/DA/101, RPA/45/DA/102, RPA/45/DA/201, Site
Location Plan&nbsp;</span></p>
description: Outbuilding at rear for ancillary use to main dwelling
